title: Custom Crosshairs Pack for Minecraft PE (30+ Free)
topic: Minecraft ka default crosshair change karna hai?
description: Minecraft ka default crosshair change karna hai? Is video mein LegendWar ke Ultimate 30+ Custom Crosshairs resource pack ka short showcase hai. Listing mein 30 se zyada design options diye gaye hain — jaise arrows, hearts, dots aur circles — aur pack settings ke slider se available variants switch kiye ja sakte hain. Different crosshair designs aapko apni screen aur playstyle ke liye comfortable aiming marker choose karne dete hain.
